candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, causing order to fail with 502 and gateway checkout to return 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment logs show 503 on /readyz too, suggesting payment may be unhealthy/unready rather than a pure application 500; exact payment-side fault not established.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout -> order -> payment chain: payment POST /v1/authorizations returns 503, order returns 502, gateway checkout returns 502. Payment logs confirm repeated 503s on /v1/authorizations. Inventory/redis path succeeds. Root cause is bounded to payment-side failure, though the underlying payment defect is not fully identified.
